title: Vegetarian Egg Fried Rice with Peas and Spring Onion
summary: A quick Chinese-style egg fried rice with sweet peas, fragrant spring onion and savoury soy sauce. It is ideal for a fast vegetarian lunch, especially when you have leftover rice to use up.
steps: Break up any clumps in the chilled cooked rice with your fingers or a spoon so the grains are loose before cooking.

Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the beaten eggs with a pinch of salt and stir quickly for 1–2 minutes until just set and softly scrambled, then transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to the pan. Add the garlic, ginger and the white parts of the spring onions, then stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add the peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes until bright green and hot through.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, tossing and pressing it against the pan, until the grains are hot and separate.
Return the scrambled egg to the pan. Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, black pepper and the green parts of the spring onions, then toss for 1 minute until evenly mixed and steaming hot.
Taste and add a little more salt if needed, then serve immediately.
